config.script:
self.view.custom.values.parentId = self.view.custom.values.itemClassId
	if self.view.custom.values.path is None: self.view.custom.values.path = ''
	self.view.custom.values.path += '\\'
	self.view.custom.values.itemClassId = None
	self.view.custom.values.itemClassName = ''
	self.view.custom.values.itemClassDescription = ''
	self.view.custom.canAdd = False	#Don't allow the user to press 'Add' again until they have saved the latest one or selected another item class
		
	return

customMethods.name: save
customMethods.script:
info = dict(self.view.custom.values)
	itemClassId = info['itemClassId']
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	if info['itemClassId'] is None:
		if system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassName': info['itemClassName'], 'parentId': info['parentId']})) is not None:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'This item class already exists'})
			system.perspective.print('This item class already exists')
			return
	
		itemClassId = system.kanoa.item.addItemClass(info, userId)
	else: system.kanoa.item.updateItemClass(info, userId)
		
	self.view.params.value.itemClassId = itemClassId
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshItemClasses", {})
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Item Class saved'})
	
	return

customMethods.name: delete
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("delete() called")

	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.item.deleteItemClass(self.view.params.value.itemClassId, userId)
	if retVal == False:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': msg})
	else:
		self.view.params.value.itemClassId = None
		system.perspective.sendMessage('clearTreeSelection', {'msgHandler': 'itemClassEditor'})
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': msg})		

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshItemClasses", {})	
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("colorPicked message received with payload " + str(payload))

	self.view.custom.values.itemClassColor = payload['color']

	return

#	system.perspective.print("updatePopupSelection msg rcvd with %s"%payload)

	if len(payload['selection']) == 0: return
	
	self.view.params.value.itemClassId = payload['selection'][0]['value']['itemClassId']

	return

#	system.perspective.print("itemClassDropped() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	draggedItem = payload['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['droppedItem']
	
	def rejectDrop(message):
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': message})
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.data')	#Undo the move the tree has already shown
	
	itemClassId = draggedItem.get('itemClassId')
	if itemClassId is None:
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.data')
		return
	
	if droppedItem is not None and droppedItem.get('itemClassId') is None:	#e.g. a parent node only shown because of the search filter
		rejectDrop('Cannot move an item class there')
		return
	
	parentId = droppedItem['itemClassId'] if droppedItem is not None else None
	if draggedItem['parentId'] == parentId:	#Dropped onto its current parent. Item classes have no sort order, so there is nothing to change
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.data')
		return
	
	draggedPath = draggedItem['path'] or ''
	droppedPath = (droppedItem['path'] or '') if droppedItem is not None else ''
	if droppedItem is not None and droppedPath.startswith(draggedPath + '\\'):
		rejectDrop('Cannot move an item class into one of its own children')
		return
	
	itemClassName = (draggedItem['itemClassName'] or '').lower()
	for sibling in system.dataset.toPyDataSet(system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'parentId': parentId})):
		if (sibling['itemClassName'] or '').lower() == itemClassName:
			rejectDrop('An item class named %s already exists there'%draggedItem['itemClassName'])
			return
	
	itemClassPath = system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(draggedPath, {})
	parentPath = system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(droppedPath, {}) if droppedItem is not None else 'the top level'
	msg = "Are you sure you want to move %s to %s"%(itemClassPath, parentPath)
	system.perspective.openPopup('moveItemClass', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text': msg, 'messageHandler': 'confirmMoveItemClass', 'inputPayload': {'itemClassId': itemClassId, 'parentId': parentId}}, title='Move Item Class?', draggable=True)
	
	return
